summary: The frozen Buchert identity, signs, factors, registered fixtures, patch-exchange invariants, FLRW limit, H_D=0 guard, type-V versus generic-VII_h separation, and algebraic-only physical-promotion route are mathematically sound. Closeout is not clean because the result calls type I externally authenticated without an explicit source claim/locator in the pinned provenance record, the typed Barrow--Tsagas helper accepts moment pairs with negative implied variance, and the machine token NO_BUCHERT_HOME is broader than the evidence unless explicitly defined as no currently authenticated home. None of these findings promotes the algebraic witness: all ten same-state physical receipts remain missing and universal type closure remains false.

claim_verdicts.claim_tier_recommendation: Retain C2 conditional and public_use=false. Retain externally_attributed_conditional_identity_plus_algebraic_only_witness after the provenance, domain-guard, and status-token findings are remediated; do not promote to a physical witness, x_C home, geometry, family, observational, or native-transfer claim.

equation_audit.buchert_identity: With V=Var_D(theta), S=<sigma_sq>_D, Q_D_B=(2/3)V-2S, Omega_Q_D_B=-Q_D_B/(6 H_D^2), and Sigma2_D_rms=S/(3 H_D^2), exact substitution gives Omega_Q_D_B=Sigma2_D_rms-V/(9 H_D^2). For finite real V and H_D!=0, equality holds iff V=0.
equation_audit.two_patch_partition: For theta_i=3H_i and weights lambda,1-lambda, V=9 lambda(1-lambda)(H_1-H_2)^2 and Q_D_B=-2[lambda sigma_sq_1+(1-lambda)sigma_sq_2]+6 lambda(1-lambda)(H_1-H_2)^2. Hence Q_D_B=0 iff V=3<sigma_sq>_D on the registered scalar carrier.

registered_fixtures.equal_expansion: H_D=2, V=0, <sigma_sq>=3, Q_D_B=-6, Omega_Q_D_B=1/4, Sigma2_D_rms=1/4, bridge residual=0
registered_fixtures.cancellation: H_D=2, V=9, <sigma_sq>=3, Q_D_B=0, Omega_Q_D_B=0, Sigma2_D_rms=1/4, bridge residual=-1/4
registered_fixtures.curvature_negative_control: diag(1,-1,0) contracted with diag(1,-1,0) in the positive spatial metric gives 2, not 0

limits_and_guards: The FLRW scalar limit H_1=H_2 and sigma_sq_1=sigma_sq_2=0 gives Q_D_B=Omega_Q_D_B=Sigma2_D_rms=0.
Weights lambda=0 or 1 and negative squared shear are rejected.
Patch exchange preserves H_D, variance, mean shear, Q_D_B, normalized coordinates, and both residuals; only patch labels and lambda_1/lambda_2 exchange.
Exact rational replay checked 387 nonzero-H_D grid states and rejected normalization in the remaining 45 zero-H_D states.
Q_D_B and Q_D_BT remain algebraically distinct: at V=0, <sigma_sq>=3, and <sigma>=1 they evaluate to -6 and -4 respectively.
equation_audit.type_boundary: The scalar identity itself is curvature-independent under the frozen Buchert assumptions. The pinned records correctly quarantine the type-V statement to one registered diagonal non-tilted construction and leave generic VII_h trace-free-curvature contraction unresolved. Repeating the scalar row for eleven labels supplies no eleven-type physical closure.
equation_audit.physical_routing: The cancellation state is an exact scalar counterexample to identifying local isotropy from Q_D_B=0, but it is not a matched spacetime. All ten registered same-state constraint, conservation, foliation, integrability, junction, curvature, and dynamical-existence receipts are MISSING, so algebraic_only is mandatory.

assumptions: Metric signature (-,+,+,+) and positive-definite flow-orthogonal spatial metric.
Pressureless irrotational geodesic dust on one compact comoving domain and one common proper-time slice.
sigma_sq=(1/2)sigma_ab sigma^ab, H_D=<theta>_D/3, and all averages use one domain measure.
0<lambda<1; patch expansion is constant within each patch for the scalar fixture; sigma_sq_i denotes the corresponding patch average.
The rational fixture coefficients use one common implicit inverse-time unit: H coefficients multiply T^-1 and sigma_sq/variance coefficients multiply T^-2.

The pinned provenance YAML is audited for internal source crosswalk and claim scope only; raw ignored archives and normalized equation-record files were not assignment inputs and were not independently reopened.

findings.title: Type I is counted as externally authenticated without an explicit external claim record
findings.details: The provenance claim list contains an explicit type-V source/locator and an unresolved generic-VII_h row, but no P170-SRC-TYPE-I claim, source_id, locator, or normalized derivation. Nevertheless the registry marks I PASS_FLAT_THREE_CURVATURE and the result card states 2/11 externally authenticated. Bianchi I flatness is mathematically standard, but the supplied provenance does not justify the adjective externally for that lane under the spec's hash-and-locator rule.
findings.impact: This does not change universal_external_closure=false, the nine unresolved lanes, algebraic_only routing, or NO positive x_C claim. It does make the exact 2/11 external-provenance statement unsupported as written.
findings.required_fix: Either add a hash-bound type-I external source claim with exact locator and normalized derivation, or distinguish one definitionally/internal-exact type-I closure plus one externally authenticated registered type-V construction and update the coverage text accordingly.

findings.title: The Barrow--Tsagas residual helper accepts physically impossible shear moments
findings.details: barrow_tsagas_residual_q computes Var(sigma)=mean_sigma_sq-mean_sigma^2 but does not require this variance to be nonnegative. The exact counterexample mean_sigma_sq=0 and mean_sigma=1 has implied variance -1 yet returns Q_D_BT=2 for zero expansion variance.
findings.impact: The current generated PR-170 identity and two-patch artifacts do not consume this helper, so their numbers are unchanged. A future caller could nevertheless label an impossible moment tuple as a physical Barrow--Tsagas residual.
findings.required_fix: Reject mean_sigma_sq < mean_sigma^2, or rename/document the helper as unchecked algebra and place a mandatory physical-domain guard at every typed consumer. Add the negative-moment fixture.

findings.title: NO_BUCHERT_HOME needs an explicitly epistemic definition
findings.details: The evidence establishes that no universal or x_C-wide Buchert home is currently authenticated: only a shear-sector conditional identity is proved, type closure is incomplete, and all same-state physical receipts are missing. The bare machine token NO_BUCHERT_HOME can instead be read as an ontological nonexistence theorem, which the algebraic counterexample does not prove.
findings.impact: The surrounding caveats, public_use=false, algebraic_only status, and forbidden-use list substantially mitigate the risk, but downstream machine consumers may read the token without that context.
findings.required_fix: Define NO_BUCHERT_HOME in the schema as NO_CURRENTLY_AUTHENTICATED_X_C_WIDE_BUCHERT_HOME, or use that narrower token directly. Preserve the existing prohibition on a positive x_C-home claim.
